opus.problem: The best-known parts of the manna story are missing. None of the clues uses it appearing on the ground each morning after the dew, the people asking 'What is it?' (Exodus 16:14-15), or leftovers breeding worms and rotting overnight (Exodus 16:20). Smaller details like the gold jar in the ark (clue 6) or it stopping at Gilgal (clue 3) are used instead. The rule says to use known stories first, so one of these should be swapped for a best-known story.
